crossRefs.note: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.
Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.
He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place…
Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.
Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!
I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep…
Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.
You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of…
You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.
Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves.
The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.
Then I called on Yahweh’s name: “Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.
He said, “I called because of my affliction to Yahweh. He answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried. You heard my…
He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able…

translations.web: Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD!
translations.kjv: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.
translations.asv: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O Jehovah.
